title: Persistence Gymnastics

services.name: Classes
services.desc: At Persistence Gymnastics we offer classes for boys and girls of all ages, from our Parent “n” Me class all the way up to adult class. parents unlimited use of workout gym during their childs class (parent must have a signed waiver on file with Persistence.) This is a Parent “n” Me class. A Coach will lead the parent and child to explore the gymnastics events and exercises in the gym together. This class is a great way to introduce your toddler to the world of gymnastics. This beginner class is for the preschooler to step out on their own. The Coach will lead the class in stretching and introduce skills on all the gymnastics
